new.name: Stray letter inserted into digital text
new.page_shows: Si vous éprouvez de la difficulté à déposer un document au moyen de l'outil électronique
new.output_says: à d déposer un document au moyen de l’outil électronique
new.why_it_matters: A word is altered (a stray 'd') in text that the PDF's own layer has correctly as 'à déposer'; search and quotation of the French fail, with no sign of error
new.lesson: Take the text layer as is where it is complete; the extra fragment appears to come from the converter's merging of the line (the layer itself has no such letter)

new.name: Invisible link-anchor text surfaces as content
new.page_shows: A table whose first column shows only the blue link text 'NEES' / 'PCG' (record type), with the company and address beside it
new.output_says: | uu-PCG-4559451-aa PCG | NOVA Gas Transmission Ltd. |
new.why_it_matters: The PDF's text layer holds tiny hidden internal-link anchor ids (uu-PCG-4559451-aa, 4pt, behind the visible label) that no reader sees; the converter prints them as cell content (22 occurrences in the file), so search and extraction return identifiers that are not on the page and the visible label sits in a different cell value
new.lesson: Drop text that is not visible (tiny, clipped, or covered) before reading order and table building; treat link annotation ids as metadata, not content
